phases.phase: 48 a name that stays the same
phases.note: the lease changed mid-phase and broke seven tests; the address is now a .local name, resolved to prove ownership
renames became aliases because a tool name is stored state; a device-less revoke revoked nothing
the same permission helper gave four different answers from two callers, so the card now names its subject
open Mail was declined and open Calendar opened a website; the launch probe this phase wrote was satisfied by a widget extension
Finder answered no AppleScript, a detached launch hid 'not installed', and the installed check denied Apple's own apps existed
"are you running" was probing for an installed app named "You"; self-state now comes from the policy engine, the audit and the task table
the stop trusted a cancel report until a test rolled the row back; restore deletes the denial instead of granting standing authority
"search Google for X" was one route away from being answered by opening a home page; the outage path is 5.01s and says network
the request mode aborts in a non-bundle helper, so the answer is UNKNOWN with the reason carried -- never DENIED
a user LaunchAgent with no secret and no inherited watchdog; uvicorn starts the app before it notices the port is taken, so the port is probed first

phases.phase: 58 the phone is not the laptop
phases.note: phone sessions scoped at the moment the bootstrap is minted; the stop-polling guard was dead code until the browser proved it
relay proven on loopback only; a dead host answers 502, never an empty list -- and off-LAN reachability stays BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY

the badge was the bug: one OpenAI-shaped POST at four call sites and no selection, so a second vendor would configure and then be called at the wrong address -- and a refused provider name still credited `model_used` with a model that never answered -- and reading the shipped readme corrected this phase's own claim about itself

Computer Use built and never demonstrated: accessibility is granted to a terminal-launched process while the app is not, so the gate that matters is the confirmation card -- and the recorder that kept the user's cursor still exposed the after-read trusting any string as an application name
the harness that publishes every score deleted 16 phases of this history when it ran -- found while measuring, fixed additively, and guarded by a test that a row it did not write survives it

phases.phase: final audit addendum: the cold start
phases.note: the flake was a cold Vision initialisation measured against a steady-state budget; its cooldown turned one slow call into five failures -- traced inside a real run, fixed, then verified on six consecutive full suites

the panel stopped saying 'cloud' when there are two vendors, the desktop read started saying which process it describes -- and the flake fix that had already been reported as done was fixed properly, after my own test poisoned the shared backend it meant to protect
